create_TRECEval: create a TRECEval instance to load TREC question-type classification data from a task path
run_TRECEval: run the TRECEval classifier to compute train and test embeddings and evaluate accuracy
loadFile_TRECEval: load a TREC data file and parse target labels into indexed categories
do_prepare_TRECEval: do_prepare TRECEval samples by combining train and test data for embedding preparation
review_TRECEval_run: review the TRECEval run method that batches embeddings and uses KFoldClassifier for evaluation
